name: Corridor
desc:
You are in a corridor. It will only end when all anomalies are reported; you are the one who does this job.

[⚠]: - The game may sometimes have jumpscares and tense moments. If you have any problems with this, be careful while playing!

[CONTROLS]: 
Shift to Run for PC
L2 to Sprint for CONSOLE

[GUIDE]:
Any anomaly seen in the corridor counts.
- Report all anomalies at the end of the corridor to progress.
- Don't let anyone pass.

Game inspired by The Exit 8 on Steam.

scripts.title: Script for
scripts.script:
local target = workspace:FindFirstChild("MapSegments")
if target then
    target = target:FindFirstChild("Segment000")
    if target then
        target = target:FindFirstChild("Debris")
        if target then
            target = target:FindFirstChild("John")
        end
    end
end

if target and target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("BasePart") then
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "JohnHighlight"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) -- yellow
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = target
    highlight.Parent = target

else
    warn("❌ Could not find workspace.MapSegments.Segment000.Debris.John")
end
